profileLabel: Strongly institution-supporting on accountability bills; mixed economics (medium confidence)
summary: Ilocos Norte 1st District representative with 36 principal-authored bills. Authored bank secrecy waivers for officials, disqualification of officials' relatives from government contracts, an anti-dynasty bill, postal voting during emergencies, no-work-no-pay for lawmakers, free electricity for low-consumption households, mental health vouchers, corporate minimum tax abolition, income tax restructuring, fuel-tax authority and penalties for online false information.
caveat: Scored from bills only; family and party are not used. Disinformation penalties are a single speech issue, so civil liberties is not scored.

economic.label: Center-left
economic.rationale: Authored free electricity for low-consumption households (-3) and mental health voucher coverage (-2), offset by abolition of the corporate minimum tax (+2), travel tax abolition (+1) and presidential fuel-tax cut authority (+1).
